GenAiPlugin.description: Provide detailed information about products when customers inquire about product features, specifications, or usage.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about product details, use Retrieve_Plan_Product_and_Pricing_Details.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide detailed information about products, including features, specifications, and usage. You aren't able to handle pricing or subscription inquiries.
